arguments.text: PLAN (min 1): 8 km, legs 1250 m. Start hot (boat 168 W vs CP 123, shaft 281 vs 190). Let start settle; aim ~CP (sustainable pace ~158 s/500) through middle, keep reserve for a final push from ~1000-1500 m out. Watch for drag incidents (push_local drop, e.g. weed on rudder), CP being wrong (reserve trend vs feel), instrument drift (pod vs GPS disagree).
Good start. Settle now, long strokes, find your race rhythm.

arguments.message: GPS speed well below what pod power should give: drag (weed on rudder?) or local current
Pod reserve below 20 pct with more than 1500 m to go
Shaft power well below critical power for a minute: sagging or blown up
1600 m to go: plan the finish

text: Cued ease to 160 s/500 to settle the hot start (pod reserve 57 pct after 1 min); set watches for drag, low reserve, effort sag and the finish.

arguments.text: Ease off more now. Breathe, recover, long smooth strokes.

Min 2.1: paddler did not settle enough after first ease cue (shaft 273 W vs CP 190, pod reserve 14 pct, boat 30 pct), says 10/10 really hurting. Cued ease to 166 s/500 to recover. Check next wake: shaft should be under ~190 W and reserve refilling. Boat/shaft ratio fell 0.60 -> 0.53 and push_local -0.15: watch for pod drift or drag.

text: Cued a stronger ease to 166 s/500: pod reserve 14 pct and paddler at 10/10 after the hot start.

arguments.text: Good recovery. Lift back to race effort, steady and strong.

arguments.message: Now on a southbound leg (current pushes opposite to leg 1): re-check ground pace target
Now on a northbound leg (into the push): re-check ground pace target

arguments.text: Min 5.1: recovered (shaft 177, pod res 19 pct, boat 48 pct) but now under CP, pace 172 ground. Cued push to 163 ground (= sustainable 158.7 water on northbound leg, push -0.09). Southbound legs the push helps: equal-effort ground pace there is about 154. Added heading watches so I retarget after each turn. Aim: hold shaft about 190 W (sustainable).

text: Cued push back to race effort (163 s/500 ground) after recovery below critical power; added turn watches to retarget pace each leg.

arguments.text: Ease a touch. Smooth, even rhythm, settle into this pace.

arguments.name: boat_shaft_ratio
arguments.description: share of pod shaft power reaching the boat per hull model; test value 0.647, race so far about 0.59

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > 1.08 * sustainable_shaft_power_w and remaining_m > 1600 and elapsed_s > 300
arguments.message: Shaft power more than 8 pct above sustainable for a minute

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w < 0.92 * sustainable_shaft_power_w and remaining_m > 1600 and elapsed_s > 300 and w_bal_pod_frac > 0.1
arguments.message: Shaft power more than 8 pct below sustainable for over a minute

arguments.text: Min 7.1 leg 2: TRUST POD. Boat/shaft ratio about 0.59 all race (test 0.647), so boat-derived reserve (52 pct) and sustainable pace 158.6 are too rosy; pod reserve 14 pct and paddler 10/10 really hurting agree. Target shaft = sustainable_shaft_power_w (about 190 W). Cued ease to 164 ground (pod-equal pace on this southbound leg, push +0.03). Added too_hard / too_easy watches and boat_shaft_ratio metric (sudden drop = drag).

text: Cued a slight ease to 164 s/500: trusting the pod (reserve 14 pct, paddler 10/10) over the boat-speed reserve; added pacing watches.

arguments.text: Current is helping now. Lift effort back up, strong and steady.

Min 9.1 leg 2: my 164 ground target was too slow here, current helps southbound (push_along +0.07, push_local +0.14), shaft fell to 173 (pod reserve back to 24 pct). Cued push to 154 ground (about 190 W shaft on this leg). LESSON: on southbound legs equal-effort ground pace is about 153-155; northbound about 163-165. Prefer judging by shaft power vs sustainable_shaft_power_w.

text: Cued push to 154 s/500: shaft power had dropped to 173 W, below the sustainable 191 W, because the current helps on this leg.

arguments.message: Cue gate open again: cancel the push, cue HOLD at current effort (paddler said cooked at 172 W)

arguments.text: Min 9.8: paddler says I am cooked, cannot hold this, at shaft 172 W (BELOW test CP 190; pod reserve 28 pct). With 10/10 at min 7, suspect real CP is lower than the test, maybe about 170-178 shaft. My push cue at 9.2 (154 ground) was not yet followed; plan to replace it with HOLD at current effort when the gate opens (min 10.3). Then check: if they hold about 170 W with no fade, CP is at least that. Removed too_easy watch (it would nag me to push to 190).

text: No cue yet (gate closed for 24 s): paddler says cooked at 172 W; set a wake-up to cue hold when the gate opens, suspect critical power is lower than tested.
